**Coaching note for the club player:**

When your queen is attacked, don't retreat passively—attack the king first! Qg5+ forces Black's king to h8, then Qg8+ sacrifices your queen to deflect the rook from defending f7. After Rxg8, Rxf7 wins a pawn with a dominating rook. Remember: a forcing check often solves tactical problems better than a quiet retreat.
